messages:
Anya: Quick UX check — thinking about adding a 'Tool stack' sidebar toggle in the Playground run history. Idea: collapsed by default to keep compact view, expandable to show function defs + params. Thoughts? Sam: Not a fan of hiding the tool list by default. When debugging I often need to scan which tools ran. Mike: Agree with Sam. Alternative: show icons row (compact) + chevron to expand full list. Icons are small and still scannable. Olivia: Accessibility flag: hover/peek patterns are an issue. If we hide by hover, keyboard and screen reader users lose access. Need a visible toggle button with aria-expanded and a skip-to content link. DesignBot: Uploaded quick mock: https://figma.com/.../playground-toolstack-mock DesignBot: Proposed button markup: ```
...
``` Keyboard focus should move into the region when expanded. Anya: Good call on keyboard focus. Also want to preserve run-history compactness for heavy logs — maybe default collapsed for history list but expanded for single-run detail view? Sam: That could work. Default collapsed in list view, auto-expand when user opens a run (or when there's a tool error). Mike: For auto-expand trigger: expand on run error or if user clicks a 'Show tool trace' CTA. Avoid surprising expansions. Olivia: Also add accessible labels for tool icons: use aria-label="Tool: , status: succeeded/failed". Color alone can't convey status. Anya: UX copy tweak: use 'Tool stack' vs 'Invocation stack' — which is clearer? My vote for 'Tool stack' (less technical to product folks). Sam: +1 for Tool stack :thumbsup: DesignBot: I'll iterate the mock and push a small prototype to the playground sandbox. Can we quickly A/B test default collapsed vs expanded (10% traffic)? Anya: Yup. I'll file an experiment ticket. Also can we capture two metrics: time-to-first-inspect (how quickly users open toolstack) and error triage speed. Mike: Dev note: backend already emits per-invocation function metadata in run traces. Exposing it is mostly UI work. Happy to PR. Olivia: Accessibility QA checklist: keyboard navigation, screen reader labels, contrast on icons, focus order. I'll write the checklist. Anya: Thanks all. Action items: DesignBot -> update mock. Mike -> small UI PR. Olivia -> a11y checklist. I'll create experiment ticket and drop link here. DesignBot: Done — pushed updated mock and a tiny prototype branch: https://github.com/redwood/playground/pull/432 Sam: Looking at the prototype now. Quick nit: reduce spacing between icon chips in compact row — feels too airy. Anya: Noted. We'll iterate after prototype feedback. Thanks everyone :heart:
